rationale: Spec alignment — pass. It accounts for sufficient proof, explicit gaps or bounded owner dispositions without treating a gap as satisfied. Design retains intent, Plan allocates proof, implementation realizes assertions and assessors decide adequacy. Markdown remains sufficient; JSON and catalogs require explicit selection. This faithfully realizes M3 and the approved TEST/DES/PLAN/SKL obligations.

Shared-quality/maintenance missing-copy, missing-source and drift cases each start from a fresh passing fixture, assert the exact intended single diagnostic and preserve the sibling bytes. These tests establish resource availability/domain/parity, not the meaning of the method.
